summary: Before starting the Gateway, the lite start path releases agent database leases whose owner PID now belongs to another Android app (EPERM), with a receipt and the same integrity re-verification OpenClaw applies to stale leases; nothing is touched while a Gateway process runs.
reason: S24 incident 28/10 19:41-19:50Z: after deploy 988c3b6d the Gateway needed Doctor maintenance and Doctor refused every start (« An agent database is in use … still open in process 6136 »). PID 6136, an OpenClaw process dead since 15:05Z, had been reused by another app: OpenClaw only accepts ESRCH as proof of death and cannot read /proc of another uid. WhatsApp was down 9 minutes and the deploy ended rollback_failed.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-gateway-preflight.py
tests.evidence: On the S24 schemas and lease rows of 28/10: only the two rows of the reused PID are released and their integrity verification cleared; a dead (ESRCH) owner and our own live Gateway stay with OpenClaw; nothing changes while a Gateway process exists or in check mode; gateway-start.sh runs the preflight before exec.

tests.name: test-agent-exec-auth-scope, test-whatsapp-network-recovery, test-runtime-start-command, test-native-turn-provenance, test-no-hardcoded-clawmobile
tests.evidence: Unchanged, still green against the edited gateway-start.sh.

architecture.reason: Extends the existing gateway preflight owner (stale-locks) with one more orphan class; no new service or store.

evidence: Gateway start script of the lite runtime only.

limitations: Full canonical CI on the final GitHub head remains required.
Leases of a dead PID not yet reused (ESRCH) are left to OpenClaw, which already releases them.
rollback: Revert this commit and redeploy the core.
